title: A rejected or unpublished Journey leaves every list right away and takes no new joins

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: A curator's reject (setJourneyStatusAction) only changes status, and listPublicPlans filtered on visibility alone, so a rejected Journey stayed on the member /journeys index, in the journeys-library widget and in the Run picker, and adoptPlanAction / adoptJourney still enrolled anyone; /discover and member search already excluded it, so the surfaces disagreed. Separately, setJourneyVisibility, deleteJourney and the curator status and delete actions revalidated only /journeys, so a Journey made private, rejected or deleted kept its ISR /discover/journeys page and share card for up to an hour (revalidate = 3600). Fixed 2026-11-17: listPublicPlans adds .neq('status', 'rejected'); planMeta returns status and both adopt doors refuse a non-author on a rejected plan (members already on it keep their access); all four actions also revalidate the /discover/journeys layout.

verify.note: Fails if listPublicPlans lists rejected plans, an adopt door lets a non-author join a rejected plan, or a visibility, status or delete action does not refresh /discover/journeys.
